brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Two hex-acc-keyhole accessories at accessory:0#-1,0#2 and accessory:0#1,0#2 on outer faces of 3-cell row, oriented outward for wall mounting
Four hex-acc-hook accessories: accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#0,0#4 on center cell and accessory:0#1,0#0 on right cell provide multiple hook points along rack face

finish.summary: Three full hex bases in a row form a horizontal wall rack, capped and joint-bolted. Two keyhole hanger accessories on the outer end cells provide wall mounting, and four wall hooks across the center and right cells provide hanging points for small hand tools. Props were not placed due to bench clearance at single-storey height, but hook hardware is present and demonstrates the purpose when wall-mounted.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
